description: This file contains functions for interacting with the Prepr CMS via GraphQL, including fetching posts, post details, and preview data.

methods.name: getAllPostsForHome
methods.description: Fetches all posts for the homepage, including metadata and author info.

methods.name: getPostAndMorePosts
methods.description: Fetches a specific post by slug along with more posts.

methods.name: getPreviewPostBySlug
methods.description: Fetches a post for preview purposes by slug.
